Elizabeth Municipal Court is the busiest court in Elizabeth, New Jersey, the state's fourth-largest city. Its mission is to provide justice and motivate public trust. Before coming into the court, the court commits people's fundamental beliefs in fairness, respect, and justice. The court is dedicated to protecting and accurately maintaining all people's records. This court mainly deals with criminal and traffic cases.

Cases:

Elizabeth Municipal Court deals with these types of cases:

  • · Traffic tickets case
  • · Without injury DUI or DWI case
  • · Small shoplifting charges case
  • · City ordinances violation
  • · Harassment charges case
  • · Simple assault case
  • · Noise complaints case

Ticket Payment:

Elizabeth Municipal Court pay ticket can be done in three ways:

In-Person

Ticket payment can be accepted at the court window during business hours.

Online

A person can pay a ticket online by using the http://www.njmcdirect.com/ court website.

Mail

A person can pay the ticket by sending checks to the court's mailing address. The mailing address is 208 Commerce Pl, Elizabeth, NJ 07201, United States. Cash is not accepted in the mail. Checks must be certified if the payment is over $500.

Marriage License

Elizabeth Municipal Court marriage license can be obtained from city hall according to the law of U.S Marriage laws. $28 is the fee for the permit. A photo ID like a Driver's license, passport for identification, Residency Proof, and a Social Security Number are mandatory for the license. A couple that wants a marriage license must fulfill the following criteria:

  • Marriage must be recognized by this state and not a member of another civil union.
  • The couple's age must be 18+. If anyone's age is below 18, consent must be approved by any superior court family part division judge.

Virtual Court

Elizabeth Municipal Court Virtual Court is a zoom meeting case hearing introduced due to coronavirus. Fill out the virtual session form, and the meeting schedule is provided to the person through the mail. A person can find their meeting ID and passport by looking on the website through their plan. All meeting IDs and passports are given according to time. It is recommended to join the meeting 30 minutes before the time. If a person does not have internet access, a case hearing can be done through mobile phone using the number 1-929-205-6099.

Online Municipal Case Resolution:

Elizabeth Municipal Court offers a no-court appearance of traffic ticket cases through online municipal case resolution. If you received a ticket, go to http://njmcdirect.com/ and enter the ticket information. Select the case dispute option if your claim is eligible for an online solution. The prosecutor will review the relevant ticket information and notify the person with the recommendation.

Traffic Violation:

Elizabeth Municipal Court traffic violation services are provided by The Parking Authority of the City of Elizabeth. Still, the payment for the violation is only paid at the violation bureau or online at http://www.njmcdirect.com/. All information is available on the back of the ticket a person received.

see also West Valley Justice Court

Report a Concern:

Elizabeth City Court provides the facility of reporting a concern. Submit the concern form online by filling in the location and concern details and identification, and attach the picture or document with it. All references are reviewed according to the Elizabeth City Police within available resources by the court during business hours.

FAQ

Where is the Elizabeth City Courthouse located?

Elizabeth City Courthouse is located at 206 E Main St, Elizabeth City, NC 27907, United States.

Where is Elizabeth Town Court located?

Elizabeth Town Court is located at 166 E Broad St, Elizabethtown, NC 28337, United States.

Which Photo Identification proof is acceptable for a marriage license?

Any identification that proves your identification, like a driver's license, passport, or baptism paper, is mandatory for getting a marriage license.

Whom can I contact for traffic violation matters?

Contact The Parking Authority of the City of Elizabeth is at 233 Commerce Place.

Elizabeth, NJ 07201 during business hours or call them.

Phone: 908-353-0949

Where will I find the city code of ordinance?

The city code of ordinance is available at the city hall of Elizabeth's court. 2018 to 2022 codes of law are available in PDF form online.

How much is the parking ticket in Elizabeth Municipal court?

Elizabeth Municipal Court parking tickets depend upon the hours. $3 for one hour, $ 10 for 10 hours, and the lost ticket fee is $20.

What is the Elizabeth Municipal court code?

Elizabeth Municipal court code is 2004, and it is a union county.

How can I schedule a virtual meeting?

Elizabeth Municipal court virtual meeting can be scheduled after you fill out the virtual court form and send it through mail or email to the court.

What will the public defender do?

Elizabeth Municipal Court public defender will help a person in the case information and all the matters. The public Defender form is available on the municipal court website.

How many open windows are in the Elizabeth Municipal Court?

Three windows open are available in Elizabeth Municipal Court that are:

  • Front Window open that is open from 8:00 am to 8:30 pm five days a week
  • Drive up Window open that is open from 8:00 am to 7:00 pm five days a week
  • Bail Window open that is open from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm five days a week

Who can perform a marriage in the court of New Jersey?

The following people have permission to perform a marriage at the court:

  • Mayor or county clerk
  • Federal District Judge Court
  • Municipal Court Judge
  • Superior Court Judge
  • Tax Court Judge
  • Magistrate of court
